Binta Traore  
Email: binta.traore@email.com | Phone: +91 9876543210 | LinkedIn: linkedin.com/in/binta-traore | Location: Bengaluru, India

- **Kubernetes**: Orchestrated production-grade deployments for 20+ microservices, ensuring zero-downtime updates and efficient resource utilization.
